name: Ho Chi Minh City
blurb: Ho Chi Minh City remains one of the most discussed destinations in the country, with steady volume across the period and no unusual movement.

positive: Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
negative: Some report crowding at peak times

quotes.text: Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
Getting harder to find a decent room under budget this year.
Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
